content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Central Employment Exchange Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.dgll.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central Employment Exchange recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Technician (Electronics) and Navigational Assistant Grade-III posts is 07-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by Central Employment Exchange?
faq.answer: Central Employment Exchange has released a total of 1 vacancy for the Technician (Electronics) and Navigational Assistant Grade-III posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Telecommunication, or Electrical and Electronics to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 27 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed at Level-5 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Technician and Navigational Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test and a Trade Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Central Employment Exchange, which is http://www.dgll.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The posts of Technician (Electronics) and Navigational Assistant Grade-III are permanent government jobs.
